SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

2. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   B. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.

9. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

13. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

14. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
